shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "pwd && rg --files -g '"'!node_modules'"' -g '"'!package-lock.json'"' -g '"'!pnpm-lock.yaml'"' -g '"'!yarn.lock'"' -g 'AGENTS.md' -g 'package.json' -g 'src/**' -g 'app/**' -g 'pages/**' -g 'index.html' -g 'vite.config.*' -g '.agents/skills/gravity-ui/**'"
/bin/bash -lc 'cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md'
/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,100p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && rg -n -C 3 'uikit|icons|navigation|upload' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md"
/bin/bash -lc 'cat package.json && cat src/App.tsx && cat src/main.tsx && cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md && ls -la'

/bin/bash -lc '.agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Button TextInput Select Switch Checkbox Avatar Text Label Alert Modal && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md && cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/icons.md'
/bin/bash -lc 'npm install @gravity-ui/navigation @gravity-ui/icons'

/bin/bash -lc "node -e \"for (const p of ['uikit','navigation','icons']) console.log(p,require('@gravity-ui/'+p+'/package.json').version)\" && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/README.md && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/README.md && rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation | rg 'INDEX.md|AsideHeader.*d.ts|types.d.ts|PageLayout'"

/bin/bash -lc 'bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Button TextInput Select Switch Checkbox Avatar Text Label Alert Modal && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md && cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/icons.md'

/bin/bash -lc "curl -Ls https://gravity-ui.com/icons -o /tmp/gravity-icons.html && python - <<'PY'
import re
s=open('/tmp/gravity-icons.html').read()
for x in ['Person','Gear','Bell','Shield','Globe','Arrow','CircleQuestion','Chevrons','Envelope','ArrowUpFromSquare','Camera']:
 print(x, sorted(set(re.findall(r'\"[A-Za-z]*'+x+r'[A-Za-z]*\"',s)))[:25])
PY"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/controls/TextInput/TextInput.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Switch/Switch.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Checkbox/Checkbox.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Avatar/types/main.d.ts && sed -n '1,180p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Select/types.d.ts && sed -n '1,150p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Button/Button.d.ts && sed -n '1,120p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/theming.md"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/README.md && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/README.md && rg -n '\"version\"|\"peerDependencies\"' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/package.json node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/package.json && rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation | rg 'INDEX.md|AsideHeader.*d.ts|types.d.ts|PageLayout'"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs/INDEX.md && sed -n '1,200p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader/types.d.ts && sed -n '1,150p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader/AsideHeader.d.ts && sed -n '117,140p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/package.json && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Avatar/AvatarImage/AvatarImage.d.ts && rg -n -C 3 'type ControlProps|interface ControlProps' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/types.d.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
import urllib.request,re
s=urllib.request.urlopen('https://gravity-ui.com/icons').read().decode()
open('/tmp/gravity-icons.html','w').write(s)
for x in ['Person','Gear','Bell','Shield','Globe','Arrow','CircleQuestion','Chevrons','Envelope','Camera','Check']:
 print(x, sorted(set(re.findall(r'[\"\\x27]([A-Za-z]*'+x+r'[A-Za-z]*)[\"\\x27]',s)))[:30])
PY"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n -C 4 'CSS|--gn-|aboveMenuContent|renderFooter|logo|width|headerDecoration' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs/components/AsideHeader.md | head -180 && sed -n '1,100p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/types.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Avatar/AvatarImage/types.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Avatar/types/common.d.ts && rg -n 'file' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/controls/TextInput/TextInputControl.* && cat tsconfig.json"

/bin/bash -lc "node --input-type=module - <<'JS'
import fs from 'node:fs';const s=fs.readFileSync('/tmp/gravity-icons.html','utf8');for(const x of ['person','shield','envelope','camera','chevron','arrow-up','circle-question','bell','globe','gear']){const i=s.indexOf(x);console.log(x,i,s.slice(Math.max(0,i-60),i+150))}
JS
rg -n -C 2 'CSS API|--gn-aside-header' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs/components/AsideHeader.md | tail -100
sed -n '100,140p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/types.d.ts
cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Modal/Modal.d.ts
cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Text/Text.d.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n -C 2 'brand|focus|selection|utility|line-generic' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/themes/_light.scss | head -90 && rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles | head -20 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader/components/PageLayout/PageLayout.css | head -80 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Alert/types.d.ts | head -90 && cat index.html"
/bin/bash -lc 'npm run build'

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n 'expanded-width|expandedWidth|240|236|220|200' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader/density.js node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader/AsideHeader.js node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader/components/Header.js && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Avatar/Avatar.css && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Button/constants.js | head -60 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader/components/PageLayout/PageLayout.js | head -65"

/bin/bash -lc "git diff --stat && npm ls @gravity-ui/uikit @gravity-ui/navigation @gravity-ui/icons @bem-react/classname && rg -n -- '--g-avatar-size|--g-text-input-border-color|--g-text-input-border-radius' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Avatar/Avatar.css node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/controls/TextInput/TextInput.css && rg -n -- '--g-color-base-generic-ultralight|--g-color-sfx-shadow:|--g-color-text-positive:|--g-color-line-generic-accent:' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/styles.css | head -15 && ls -lh public/avatar.jpg && rg -n 'buttonProps|type:|type =' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Button/Button.js | head -20"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,100p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/layout.md && git status --short && cat .gitignore && rg -n 'prepareChildren' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Button/Button.js && sed -n '1,70p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Button/Button.js && rg -n -- '--g-font-family-sans|--g-font-family:' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/styles.css | head -8"
/bin/bash -lc 'npm run build && git diff --check'
